records.title: Focal Reward: Balanced Reinforcement Learning under Rubric-Based Rewards
records.reason: Focal Reward changes the rubric-reward aggregation objective for RL post-training; its metrics concern learned behavior rather than inference cost.

records.title: Spend Your Rollouts Where It Counts: Rollout Allocation for Group-Based RL Post-Training
records.reason: Pilot-Commit allocates rollouts more efficiently during RL post-training and reports faster target accuracy in cumulative rollouts; this is training sampling cost, not serving/inference optimization.

records.title: UnityMAS-O: A General RL Optimization Framework for LLM-Based Multi-Agent Systems
records.reason: UnityMAS-O is an RL optimization framework for training multi-agent LLM workflows; it improves post-training workflows rather than inference resource efficiency.

records.title: EDGE-OPD: Internalizing Privileged Context with Evidence Guided On-Policy Distillation
records.reason: EDGE-OPD is an evidence-guided on-policy distillation training method; it does not report lower inference compute, memory, latency, or serving cost.
